text:
Tom H: noticing a discrepancy in the month-end deferral reconciliation. Usage overage credits were invoiced, but the revenue schedule shows the overage amounts as deferred under DEF-COMMIT when they should have flowed to immediate revenue per policy. sample extract below.
Yvonne L: pls paste the rows and how the billing system labeled them.
Tom H: billing CSV excerpt:
```
invoice_id,customer,invoice_date,charge_type,amount,billing_treatment
INV-2026-0703,neon-ai,2026-04-07,usage-overage,4200,immediate
INV-2026-0725,neon-ai,2026-04-21,usage-overage,1800,immediate
```
Tom H: scheduler extract shows those same invoices tied to DEF-COMMIT-36M with deferral_amounts 6000 total. looks like a mapping rule applied partner-commit deferral to the customer's account because their default deferral flag was set at the customer level.
Carlos M: materiality?
Tom H: $6k recognized incorrectly as deferred (reduces recognized rev for Apr). Not huge but above our $5k internal threshold.
Yvonne L: contract policy states overages recognized immediately unless explicitly part of a committed credit. these were standalone overages. we need to reverse the deferral and post revenue recognition.
Carlos M: proposed correction JE for May close: DR 2300-DEFERRED-COMMIT $6,000 / CR 4000-REVENUE-USAGE $6,000 with memo "reverse misapplied deferral for usage overages - ticket RR-2026-0615". Then update schedules to remove DEF-COMMIT lines for those invoices and post recognition to Apr if possible via a prior-period adjustment.
Tom H: cash was posted in Apr for both invoices. We should treat as prior-period correction in May close but include footnote in May schedule referencing Apr impact.
Yvonne L: also need remediation: update customer default deferral flag and add validation in billing pipeline to check invoice charge_type vs deferral code mismatch. open ticket and attach sample logs.
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0615 created and assigned to @Tom H; due 2026-05-04; attachments required: billing export, schedule extract, customer config snapshot.
Tom H: attaching PR to billing rules repo to add a guard: https://git.internal/redwood/billing-rules/pull/127. will attach logs to ticket.
Carlos M: i approve the JE and the remediation plan. Yvonne?
Yvonne L: approve. add schedule note: "Correction of misapplied deferral for usage overages due to customer-level deferral flag; amounts reclassified to immediate revenue (RR-2026-0615)."
Tom H: thanks all. i'll post the JE in May close and update the revenue schedule. will follow up if auditors ask for docs. :white_check_mark:
